title: Sephiria Secret Rooms — Cracked Walls & Hidden Room Guide
description: Sephiria secret rooms guide: how to find hidden rooms behind cracked walls, what’s inside, the Traveler achievement, and the post-Erma lore room.
meta: For sephiria secret rooms / hidden room searches.
body:
Sephiria secret rooms (also searched as hidden rooms) are an achievement (“Traveler”) and a real loot swing: a few seconds of wall-checking per floor buys leaves, Artifacts/Tablets, dice, or rare potions.

How to spot cracked walls

  • Scan dungeon walls for subtle cracks near the top — they are small, so sweep each corridor wall once.
  • Walk up and strike the crack. A notification confirms the find.
  • The room then appears on the map without a drawn passage.

What’s inside

Rewards reported by the community include leaves, Artifacts/Tablets, dice, or rare potions — worth taking even on throwaway floors.

Does the map show them?

Only after you open one. Cracked walls do not render on the map beforehand, which is why the “hidden room” phrasing fits: you find them by eye, not by minimap.

The post-Erma lore room

After defeating Erma, cross the bridge; on the left side of the table in the next room you can walk under the wall—no crack required. Players report it as mostly lore.

Quick FAQ

How many secret rooms are there?
The community is still counting; the “Traveler” achievement tracks the milestone, and no fixed total is documented.

Do they respawn?
No respawn behavior is documented — treat rooms as per-dungeon finds.

Treat the crackless room as community experience; cracked-wall rooms are documented in the Steam Basic Guide with screenshots.
